tools.name: keypay_get_user
tools.description: The Employment Hero Payroll user this API key belongs to: id, email, display name and time zone. GET /user.

tools.name: keypay_list_businesses
tools.description: List the payroll businesses this user can access: id, name, region, legal name, contact details, pay cycle, number of employees. Start here: most other tools need a business id. GET /business (OData).

tools.name: keypay_get_business
tools.description: One business by id: name, legal name, contact, address, ABN/company details, leave year, standard hours, pay cycle. GET /business/{businessId}.

tools.name: keypay_list_employees
tools.description: List the business's employees with basic details: id, name, preferred name, gender, date of birth, contact details, address, start and end date, external id. Tax file, bank and super details are not part of this list. Filter with OData, e.g. "Surname eq 'Smith'". GET /business/{businessId}/employee/

tools.name: keypay_get_employee
tools.description: One employee's full record: name, contact, employment type, status, start/end date, pay schedule, primary location and pay category, rate and rate unit, hours per week, award, leave template, work types, tags. Tax file / national insurance / IRD / NRIC numbers, bank accounts and super member numbers

tools.name: keypay_get_leave_balances
tools.description: An employee's leave balances per leave category (accrued amount and unit), optionally as at a date. GET /business/{businessId}/employee/{employeeId}/leavebalances.

tools.name: keypay_list_pay_runs
tools.description: List the business's pay runs: id, pay schedule, pay period start/end, date paid, finalised flag, payslips published, notation. Newest first with orderby "PayPeriodEnding desc". GET /business/{businessId}/payrun (OData).

tools.name: keypay_get_pay_run
tools.description: One pay run by id: pay schedule, period, date paid, whether it is finalised, notation. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/{payRunId}.

tools.name: keypay_list_pay_run_summaries
tools.description: Pay runs with their totals: total hours, gross wages and net wages, plus the usual pay run fields. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/summary (OData).

tools.name: keypay_get_pay_run_summary
tools.description: One pay run with its total hours, gross wages and net wages. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/{payRunId}/summary.

tools.name: keypay_get_pay_run_totals
tools.description: Per-employee totals of a pay run (gross, net, tax withheld, super and the like; the fields depend on the region). Bank payment details are removed. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/{payRunId}/totals.

tools.name: keypay_get_pay_run_payslips
tools.description: Pay slip data for every employee in a pay run, keyed by employee: earnings lines, deductions, tax, super, leave taken and accrued, gross/net and year-to-date totals. Large for big pay runs. Bank account numbers and tax/identity numbers are removed. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/{payRunId}/paysli

tools.name: keypay_list_pay_run_warnings
tools.description: Warnings on a pay run (for example an employee paid below their award rate or with a negative net pay): type, employee and message. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/{payRunId}/warnings.

tools.name: keypay_list_timesheets
tools.description: List the business's timesheet lines: employee, start/end time, units, work type, location, status, comments, breaks. Filter by employee or date with OData, e.g. "EmployeeId eq 123 and StartTime gt datetime'2026-04-01T00:00:00'". GET /business/{businessId}/timesheet (OData: $filter, $orderby, $top, $

tools.name: keypay_get_timesheet
tools.description: One timesheet line by id. GET /business/{businessId}/timesheet/{timesheetLineId}.

tools.name: keypay_list_leave_requests
tools.description: List the business's leave requests: employee, leave category, from/to date, total hours, status (Approved, Pending, Rejected, Cancelled), notes. Filter by status, dates, category, location or employee. GET /business/{businessId}/leaverequest.

tools.name: keypay_get_leave_request
tools.description: One leave request: employee, category, dates, hours, status, notes. GET /business/{businessId}/employee/{employeeId}/leaverequest/{leaveRequestId}.

tools.name: keypay_list_leave_categories
tools.description: Leave categories of the business (annual, personal/sick, long service...): id, name, unit type, accrual rule. GET /business/{businessId}/leavecategory (OData).

tools.name: keypay_list_pay_schedules
tools.description: Pay schedules of the business: id, name, frequency, last date paid, last pay run. Bank and tax account details are removed. GET /business/{businessId}/payschedule (OData).

tools.name: keypay_list_locations
tools.description: Locations of the business (sites, departments): id, name, parent, fully qualified name, state. GET /business/{businessId}/location (OData).

tools.name: keypay_list_pay_categories
tools.description: Pay categories (earnings types) of the business: id, name, rate unit, loadings, super rate, whether leave accrues. GET /business/{businessId}/paycategory (OData).

tools.name: keypay_list_work_types
tools.description: Work types of the business: id, name, pay category, leave category, short code. GET /business/{businessId}/worktype (OData).

tools.name: keypay_report_gross_to_net
tools.description: Gross-to-net report per employee: earnings by pay category, tax, deductions, super, net pay. Choose a date range (from_date + to_date) or one finalised pay run (pay_run_id). The report has no paging: at most 200 rows are returned (narrow with employee_id or location_id). GET /business/{businessId}/r

tools.name: keypay_report_leave_balances
tools.description: Leave balances of all employees as at a date, per leave category. The report has no paging: at most 200 rows are returned (narrow with location_id or leave_category_id). For one employee use keypay_get_leave_balances. GET /business/{businessId}/report/leavebalances.

tools.name: keypay_approve_leave_request
tools.description: WRITE: approves a pending leave request (the employee is notified and the leave is applied to their pay). Check the request first with keypay_get_leave_request. Cannot be undone through this server. POST /business/{businessId}/employee/{employeeId}/leaverequest/{leaveRequestId}/approve.

tools.name: keypay_decline_leave_request
tools.description: WRITE: declines a leave request, with an optional reason the employee sees. Check the request first with keypay_get_leave_request. POST /business/{businessId}/employee/{employeeId}/leaverequest/{leaveRequestId}/decline.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: keypay_get_user, keypay_list_pay_run_warnings, keypay_list_timesheets, keypay_approve_leave_request, keypay_decline_leave_request · Private data: keypay_get_user, keypay_list_businesses, keypay_get_business, keypay_list_employees, keypay_get_employee · Public sink: keypay_get_user, keypay_approve_leave_request, keypay_decline_leave_request · Destructive: keypay_get_pay_run, keypay_list_pay_run_summaries, keypay_get_pay_run_summary, keypay_get_pay_run_totals, keypay_get_pay_run_payslips, keypay_list_pay_run_warnings, keypay_list_pay_schedules, keypay_report_gross_to_net.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: keypay_get_user, keypay_list_pay_run_warnings, keypay_list_timesheets, keypay_approve_leave_request, keypay_decline_leave_request · Private data: keypay_get_user, keypay_list_businesses, keypay_get_business, keypay_list_employees, keypay_get_employee · Public sink: keypay_get_user, keypay_approve_leave_request, keypay_decline_leave_request · Destructive: keypay_get_pay_run, keypay_list_pay_run_summaries, keypay_get_pay_run_summary, keypay_get_pay_run_totals, keypay_get_pay_run_payslips, keypay_list_pay_run_warnings, keypay_list_pay_schedules, keypay_report_gross_to_net

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
